svg.title: Mr. Biriyaniwala — Hyderabadi dum and charcoal
svg.desc: An animated film-poster banner. A copper handi sealed with dough sits inside a warm arch, steam rising, spices drifting. The wordmark reads Mr. Biriyaniwala, with the line A little fire, a lot of soul.

g.text: A little fire. A lot of soul.
tandoor and a table for your people.
